summary: Briefly lord of the manor of Remingham and Cow in Wraysbury, Buckinghamshire, in the reign of James I; John's 12th-great-grandfather.
bio: Ambrose Aldridge was for a short time lord of the manor of Remingham and Cow in Wraysbury, Buckinghamshire, England. He bought the manor in 1611 and sold it two years later, in 1613, for £500. He is John's 12th-great-grandfather.
